name.full: CSM Advisor for Microsoft Copilot Cowork

description.short: Role-based Microsoft Learn skilling paths from your files and recaps.
description.full: CSM Advisor turns your Word, PDF, text, PowerPoint and Excel files, plus your Microsoft Teams meeting recaps if you ask, into role-based Microsoft Learn skilling paths. It works in four stages with your approval after each: collect artifacts, detect signals and write a Signals Summary Word document, hand-pick Microsoft Learn modules, and build a Skilling Paths proposal Word document for Leaders, Champions, Advocates and End Users based on role and prerequisite skills.
